fullText.simplified:
十六、求仙药

    时间慢慢过去，天终于亮了。
    雄黄酒的药力过去了，白素贞变回了人形。她从床上坐起，一眼看到了倒在床边的许仙。
    她连忙下床看，发现许仙已经死了，而且已经死了好几个小时了。
    白素贞大哭起来，“他一定看到我的原形了！是我吓死了他！”
    她越哭越难过，哭得天都变黑了，雨也落了下来。
    突然，难过的她想到了什么，“一定还有办法！我去找神仙！神仙一定能让他活过来！”
    她不哭了，把许仙放在床上。然后用了一个法术，飞向外面。
    她飞到了天上，来到神仙们住的天宫外，大哭着说：“我是白素贞，来求仙药，求大仙们给我仙药，让我的相公起死回生！”
    一个声音在天上说：“大胆蛇妖！这是什么地方，你怎么敢来这里！”
    一道金色的闪电劈下来，白素贞没有躲，闪电劈在身上，真疼啊！但她忍住了，又大声说：“只要能救回我的相公，什么事情我都愿意做！求大仙们救救我的相公！”
    那个声音没有说话，但用金色的闪电回答了她。更多的闪电劈在白素贞身上，她一千年的修炼也帮不了她，她越来越疼，感觉自己快要死了，但她没有放弃，一直说：“求求大仙救救我的相公……”
    她的声音越来越小，越来越小……
    这时天上出现了一个新的声音，“不要打了，她怀孕了，她肚子里的孩子没有做错事。”
    闪电消失了。
    然后，这个新的声音说：“白素贞，天宫没有起死回生的药，你来错地方了。”
    “求大仙告诉我，哪儿有起死回生的药？”白素贞问。
    “你去南海找南极仙翁吧。”这个声音说完，天地安静了，一点儿声音都没有了。
    白素贞慢慢爬起来，忍着疼说：“谢谢大仙。”
    说完，她的身体向下一倒，飞向南海。
    南海不是海的名字，而是一座仙山的名字，那座仙山在一片海上。仙山上的树又高又大，仙气很重，是个普通人到不了的地方。
    白素贞落在山脚，大声说：“我是白素贞，来求南极仙翁救救我相公！”
    刚说完，前面出现了两个人。一男一女，长得十分好看，一看就是仙人。
    “白素贞，我们是南极仙翁的弟子。天宫不给你药，仙翁就能给你药吗？”男神仙说。
    “许仙是被你吓死的，如果他是真心爱你的，会这么怕你吗？你为什么要救他？”女神仙说。
    白素贞不说话，忍着疼，从身上拿出一个药瓶。

十六、求仙藥

    時間慢慢過去，天終於亮了。
    雄黃酒的藥力過去了，白素貞變回了人形。她從床上坐起，一眼看到了倒在床邊的許仙。
    她連忙下床看，發現許仙已經死了，而且已經死了好幾個小時了。
    白素貞大哭起來，“他一定看到我的原形了！是我嚇死了他！”
    她越哭越難過，哭得天都變黑了，雨也落了下來。
    突然，難過的她想到了什麼，“一定還有辦法！我去找神仙！神仙一定能讓他活過來！”
    她不哭了，把許仙放在床上。然後用了一個法術，飛向外面。
    她飛到了天上，來到神仙們住的天宮外，大哭著說：“我是白素貞，來求仙藥，求大仙們給我仙藥，讓我的相公起死回生！”
    一個聲音在天上說：“大膽蛇妖！這是什麼地方，你怎麼敢來這裡！”
    一道金色的閃電劈下來，白素貞沒有躲，閃電劈在身上，真疼啊！但她忍住了，又大聲說：“只要能救回我的相公，什麼事情我都願意做！求大仙們救救我的相公！”
    那個聲音沒有說話，但用金色的閃電回答了她。更多的閃電劈在白素貞身上，她一千年的修煉也幫不了她，她越來越疼，感覺自己快要死了，但她沒有放棄，一直說：“求求大仙救救我的相公……”
    她的聲音越來越小，越來越小……
    這時天上出現了一個新的聲音，“不要打了，她懷孕了，她肚子裡的孩子沒有做錯事。”
    閃電消失了。
    然後，這個新的聲音說：“白素貞，天宮沒有起死回生的藥，你來錯地方了。”
    “求大仙告訴我，哪兒有起死回生的藥？”白素貞問。
    “你去南海找南極仙翁吧。”這個聲音說完，天地安靜了，一點兒聲音都沒有了。
    白素貞慢慢爬起來，忍著疼說：“謝謝大仙。”
    說完，她的身體向下一倒，飛向南海。
    南海不是海的名字，而是一座仙山的名字，那座仙山在一片海上。仙山上的樹又高又大，仙氣很重，是個普通人到不了的地方。
    白素貞落在山腳，大聲說：“我是白素貞，來求南極仙翁救救我相公！”
    剛說完，前面出現了兩個人。一男一女，長得十分好看，一看就是仙人。
    “白素貞，我們是南極仙翁的弟子。天宮不給你藥，仙翁就能給你藥嗎？”男神仙說。
    “許仙是被你嚇死的，如果他是真心愛你的，會這麼怕你嗎？你為什麼要救他？”女神仙說。
    白素貞不說話，忍著疼，從身上拿出一個藥瓶。

sentences.pinyin: gāng shuō wán qián miàn chū xiàn le liǎng ge rén
sentences.english: As soon as she finished speaking, two people appeared in front of her.

sentences.simplified: 一男一女，长得十分好看，一看就是仙人。
sentences.traditional: 一男一女，長得十分好看，一看就是仙人。
sentences.pinyin: yì nán yì nǚ zhǎng de shí fēn hǎo kàn yí kàn jiù shì xiān rén
sentences.english: A man and a woman, both very good-looking. They clearly appeared to be immortals.

sentences.simplified: “白素贞，我们是南极仙翁的弟子。
sentences.traditional: “白素貞，我們是南極仙翁的弟子。
sentences.pinyin: bái sù zhēn wǒ men shì nán jí xiān wēng de dì zǐ
sentences.english: “Bai Suzhen, we are disciples of the Old Immortal of the South Pole.

sentences.simplified: 天宫不给你药，仙翁就能给你药吗？”男神仙说。
sentences.traditional: 天宮不給你藥，仙翁就能給你藥嗎？”男神仙說。
sentences.pinyin: tiān gōng bù gěi nǐ yào xiān wēng jiù néng gěi nǐ yào ma nán shén xiān shuō
sentences.english: If the Heavenly Palace didn’t give you medicine, do you think that the Old Immortal can give you medicine?” the male immortal said.

sentences.simplified: “许仙是被你吓死的，如果他是真心爱你的，会这么怕你吗？
sentences.traditional: “許仙是被你嚇死的，如果他是真心愛你的，會這麼怕你嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xǔ xiān shì bèi nǐ xià sǐ de rú guǒ tā shì zhēn xīn ài nǐ de huì zhè me pà nǐ ma
sentences.english: “Xu Xian was scared to death by you. If he truly loved you, would he be so scared of you?

sentences.simplified: 你为什么要救他？”女神仙说。
sentences.traditional: 你為什麼要救他？”女神仙說。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me yào jiù tā nǚ shén xiān shuō
sentences.english: Why do you want to save him?” the female immortal said.

sentences.simplified: 白素贞不说话，忍着疼，从身上拿出一个药瓶。
sentences.traditional: 白素貞不說話，忍著疼，從身上拿出一個藥瓶。
sentences.pinyin: bái sù zhēn bù shuō huà rěn zhe téng cóng shēn shang ná chū yí ge yào píng
sentences.english: Bai Suzhen didn’t speak. Enduring the pain, she took out the medicine bottle she had on her.

sentence_translations: 16. Seeking the Elixir of the Immortals
Time passed slowly, and finally, the sky brightened.
The effect of the realgar wine wore off, and Bai Suzhen returned to her human form.
She sat up from the bed and immediately saw Xu Xian collapsed beside the bed.
She hurriedly got out of bed to look.
She found that Xu Xian was already dead, and he had already been dead for several hours.
Bai Suzhen started to cry loudly: “He must have seen my true form! I scared him to death!”
The more she cried, the sadder she became. She cried until the sky turned dark, and rain began to fall.
Suddenly, a thought occurred to her in her sadness:
“There must be a way! I will go find the immortals! The immortals will surely be able to bring him back to life!”
She stopped crying and placed Xu Xian on the bed. Then, she used a spell and flew outside.
She flew up to the heavens, arriving outside the Heavenly Palace where the immortals lived.
She cried out, “I am Bai Suzhen, here to seek the elixir of the immortals.
I beg the great immortals to give me divine medicine to bring my husband back to life!”
A voice in the heavens said, “Audacious snake demon! Do you know where this is? How dare you come here!”
A bolt of golden lightning struck down. Bai Suzhen didn’t dodge it. The bolt of lightning hit her, and it really hurt!
But she endured the pain and said again loudly, ..
.. “As long as I can save my husband, I’m willing to do anything! I beg the immortals to save my husband!”
The voice did not speak but answered her with golden lightning.
More lightning struck Bai Suzhen’s body, and even her thousand years of cultivation couldn’t help her.
She was in more and more pain and felt like she was about to die.
But she didn’t give up and kept saying, “Please, great immortals, save my husband …”
Her voice grew softer and softer, softer and softer …
At this moment, a new voice appeared in the sky, ..
.. “Don’t strike her, she is pregnant. The child in her womb has done nothing wrong.”
The lightning disappeared.
Then, this new voice said, ..
.. “Bai Suzhen, there is no medicine to bring the dead back to life in the Heavenly Palace. You have come to the wrong place.”
“Please, great immortal, tell me where I can find a medicine that can bring the dead back to life?” Bai Suzhen asked.
“You should go to Nanhai and find the Old Immortal of the South Pole.”
After this voice finished speaking, the heavens and the earth fell silent, and there was not a sound to be heard.
Bai Suzhen slowly got up, enduring the pain, and said, “Thank you, great immortal.”
After speaking, her body tilted downward and flew towards Nanhai.
Nanhai was not the name of a sea, but instead the name of an immortal mountain. That immortal mountain was located on the sea.
The trees on the immortal mountain were tall and large, exuding a strong ethereal quality.
It was a place where ordinary people could not go.
Bai Suzhen landed at the foot of the mountain and said loudly, ..
.. “I am Bai Suzhen, here to ask the Old Immortal of the South Pole to save my husband!”
As soon as she finished speaking, two people appeared in front of her.
A man and a woman, both very good-looking. They clearly appeared to be immortals.
“Bai Suzhen, we are disciples of the Old Immortal of the South Pole.
If the Heavenly Palace didn’t give you medicine, do you think that the Old Immortal can give you medicine?” the male immortal said.
“Xu Xian was scared to death by you. If he truly loved you, would he be so scared of you?
Why do you want to save him?” the female immortal said.
Bai Suzhen didn’t speak. Enduring the pain, she took out the medicine bottle she had on her.
